newsitem.title: USA: RehabCare to begin calendar-year reporting.
newsitem.headline: RehabCare to begin calendar-year reporting.

text.p: RehabCare Group Inc on Tuesday said it would change the end of its fiscal year to December 31 from February 28, effective December 31, 1996.
As a result, RehabCare, which provides rehabiliation services, said its results for the most recent fourth quarter would reflect the company's performance in the month of December 1996.

Company officials said the conversion should eliminate confusion that sometimes crops up when health-care industry analysts compare RehabCare's results with those of competitors that report on calendar-based years.
Its shares were down 5/8 at 20-1/8 in early afternoon trading on the Nasdaq.
